info.name: Dataiku API Node Administration API
info.description:
REST API for administering Dataiku API Nodes, managing deployed services, service generations, prediction endpoints, and authentication keys for real-time API serving of machine learning models and data lookups.

Contact Support:
 Name: Dataiku Support
 Email: support@dataiku.com
